facts.fact: Parliament's Higher Education and Training committee was briefed by MICT SETA that the Integrated Learner Management System, meant to integrate the various post-school entities' systems into one national shared platform for real-time data sharing, is being developed and is now piloted in a couple of SETAs, though an IP dispute with Tshwane University of Technology and weak DHET buy-in could delay it.

systems.platform: built by TUT Faculty of ICT
systems.owner: MICT SETA and Tshwane University of Technology (IP ownership disputed)

systems.system: Higher Education and Training Management Information System (HETMIS)
systems.owner: Department of Higher Education and Training
systems.tiers: comprised TVET, SETA and community education MIS
